Package hkust.marketplace.data

Class DataStore

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.data.DataStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DataStore extends Object implements Serializable
In-memory store for every record, saved to one file so data survives restarts. Services lock on the store (synchronized (store)) for actions that must be atomic, such as two buyers claiming the same giveaway.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public static DataStore load(Path file) throws IOException
      Loads the store from a file, or returns an empty store bound to that file if it does not exist.
      Parameters:
      file - data file
      Returns:
      the loaded store
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file exists but cannot be read

    • save

      public void save() throws IOException
      Saves every record to the bound file (written to a temporary file first, then moved into place). Does nothing for a store without a file.
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails

    • commit

      public void commit()
      Saves the store, turning an I/O failure into an unchecked exception (used after every change).
      Throws:
      UncheckedIOException - if the data cannot be written

    • transact

      public <T> T transact(Supplier<T> change)
      Saves a group of changes together. A failed save restores the previous in-memory records. The callback must not call commit itself.
